source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: The Senate President, the Presiding Officer, and Senator-Judges of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Sergeant at Arms is directed to

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Kiko Pangilinan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: Ilagay natin ang ating mga sarili sa harap ng Panginoon. Ngayong tatlumpu?t pangalawang araw ng impeachment trial, naway maging gabay nating lahat ang salita ng Diyos mula sa Proverbs 18:5. Hindi mabuting magpakita ng pagkiling sa masama o ipagkait ang katarungan sa matuwid. It is not good to be partial to the wicked and so deprive the innocent of justice. Panginoon Diyos ng katarungan, katotohanan, at katapatan, dalangin namin ang kalinawan ng isip at katatagan ng paninindigan. Tulungan niyo po kaming maging patas ang aming mga pagsusuri sa bawat ebidensya at testigong inihaharap sa impeachment court na ito. Naway maging gabay din ng lahat ang Proverbs 12:22 Namumuhi si Yahweh sa mga taong sinungaling, ngunit ang tapat ay ligaya niya at aliw. The Lord detests lying lips, but He delights in people who are trustworthy. Kalugdan mo o Diyos ang aming inang bayang Pilipinas na uhaw sa katotohanan, katarungan, pananagutan. Look with favor O God, upon our motherland,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: Philippines, a nation that thirsts for truth and justice. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call of members. Senator-Judge Aquino, Senator-Judge Cayetano Alan, Senator-Judge Cayetano Pia, Senator-Judge Dela Rosa, Senator-Judge Ejercito, Senator-Judge Estrada, Senator-Judge Go, Senator-Judge Hontiveros, Senator-Judge Lacson, Senator-Judge Lapid, Senator-Judge Legarda, Senator-Judge Marcoleta, Senator-Judge Marcos, Senator-Judge Padilla, Senator-Judge Pangilinan, Senator-Judge Sotto III, Senator-Judge Tulfo Erwin, Senator-Judge Tulfo Raffy, Senator-Judge Villanueva, Senator-Judge Villar Camille, Senator-Judge Villar Mark, Senator-Judge Zubiri, the presiding officer, Senator-Judge Escudero, the Senate President, Senator-Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 13 senator-judges present, the chair declares the presence of a quorum.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: In accordance with the rules of procedure on impeachment trials, the chair now recognizes the duly elected presiding officer to preside over the proceedings of the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the September 29, 2026 Journal of the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, and shall consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will please read, rather, call the case before the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026 in the matter of impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Appearances of the parties.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Same appearance for the prosecution, Your Honor. We are ready.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Same appearance for the respondent accused.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Good morning, Honorable Luistro. Good morning, Attorney Poa. I hope, like the Senator-Judges, you were able to... Get some rest and respite from the procedural pause that we had yesterday. Yes, what is the pleasure of the Honorable Luistro?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We wish to manifest Your Honor that we will be beginning our presentation with the two LRA witnesses for this morning and in the afternoon, Your Honor, it will be the AMLC Executive Director.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And tomorrow? So that we can prepare the subpoenas?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We will be manifesting the witness for tomorrow, Your Honor, this afternoon before we adjourn.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay, but you already submitted a request for subpoena.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: I believe, Your Honor, that's for the representatives of banks and insurance companies for next week, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly look into it as well, Honorable Luistro, because we will be having, this is our first whole day trial. Tomorrow will be for one whole day too.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'd rather have more witnesses in line than lacking witnesses and having to adjourn early. So you might want to add more witnesses for tomorrow and deduct it from your Monday witness list.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We will do, Your Honor, before the adjournment today.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If possible, after we resume.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: After we resume. After lunch. After we resume, after the lunch recess.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We submit, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So we can issue the subpoena.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Attorney Poa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: May we just respectfully request from our colleagues in the prosecution panel to just give us the list of the order of their witnesses as to be presented just so, Your Honor, we have fair notice and we are able to prepare for these witnesses.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So today, who is the first witness?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We will be presenting the two LRA witnesses first, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Who is the first?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, at this juncture, may I respectfully request that my colleague, my co-public prosecutor, Congressman Keith Flores be recognized so that he can address the questions concerning the first witnesses to be presented.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Of course, the Honorable Flores is recognized.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor, excuse me, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: But as to our request for the order of witnesses, I hope that will also include...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: At least for today, can we get that order? And can we get the order for tomorrow as well as for next week after lunch? Can we have the order for today, Honorable Flores?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We will be presenting the two LRA representatives, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: who will go first? You have two LRAs.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, we will be calling first Attorney Cathy Florence Baldonado, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: of Davao City, followed by Attorney Pineda of the City of Samal.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And thereafter, the MLC, if you still have time.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Thank you,

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor. Thank you. That is all.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would that be satisfactory, Attorney Paul?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And then after lunch, we get to hear the sequence for Friday and for Monday.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. We appreciate that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As well as the other witnesses, they are asking the issuance of a subpoena against... You've received the request for subpoena, Attorney Poa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, your honor. We confirmed receipt last night at 8.40 p.m.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. We have a fresh start for today then. Attorney, or rather, Honorable Flores, kindly call your first witness. It's Attorney Cathy Florence

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Baldonado, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes. The clerk. Yes, Attorney Poa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor, may I turn over the proceedings to our co-counsel, Attorney Lindon Bacquel, for this witness, Your Honor. Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: While we're calling the witness, Attorney Lindon, would you like the Apple box or platform?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. No need, Your Honor. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What is the pleasure of Senator-Judge Tulfo?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, my question pertains to the witness, Attorney Trillanes, if he's going to be presented tomorrow? or the day after tomorrow, or I don't know, next week. Is he going to be presented as witness?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Trillanes?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Flores, can you respond to the query of the Honorable Tulfo?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, we will be informing the Court after lunch, Your Honor, once we get our business in order, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: pa po natin iniisuan ng subpoena ang dating senador na si Senator Sonny Trillanes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Ba't napag-usapan na ba na kung siya ay papayagan o hindi?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As stated

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: by the court yesterday, given the motion for the issuance of subpoena predicated upon the presentation and evidence of AMLC and or bank records, The court declined to issue the subpoena without prejudice to the prosecution calling him and to appear voluntarily as a witness. However, given the sequence of presentation of the witnesses to be announced by the counsel, rather by the Honorable Flores from the panel of prosecutors, the court may issue that subpoena after it hears the sequence and that it is in order in line with the motion for the request of the subpoena earlier filed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Correct. Kasi kung kukuning witness si former Senator Trillanes, much better kung mauna muna siya bago ang AMLA. Kasi yung mga sasabihin ni Mr. Trillanes, may kinalaman sa mga bank accounts na kanyang nakalap long time ago. So kung meron siya mga ibubulgar na mga bank accounts, mga pera, pumasok labas sa accounts na nakuha niya sa kanyang source, then after makausap natin si Senator Trillanes, Iko-confirm yun ang AMLA. So dapat mauna muna si Trillanes, Mr. Trillanes, and then AMLA. Hindi pwede yung AMLA and then Trillanes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: What do you think, Prosecutor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Let's allow the Prosecutors, Senator-Judge Tulfo, to decide on that after lunch, as they said. Kasi

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: kuminsan, yung prosecution, sorry, pumapalpak-palpak kayo. There are times na naglalagay kayo ng mga witnesses dito na hindi naman kailangan talaga. Nagsasayang lang tayo ng oras. Nakikita naman yung mga senador inaantok. Yung iba pa na yung punta ng CR kasi wala eh. Parang useless eh. Di ba? So kukuha kayo ng witness. Make sure na talaga yung witness na yun. Merong masasabing bagay na makatulong sa ginagawa ng investigasyon dito sa impeachment. [unclear] kinuha na pinagtatawanan tuloy. Napapa-cute lang habang may kinakausap na witness na polis, etc. So, ingat kayo sa pagkukuha ng mga witness at ingat kayo sa pagsasalan ng mga abogado ninyo dyan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: We will take due notice and consider the advice of the Senator-Judge. Thank you very much.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The remarks of the Honorable Tulfo are noted and the Prosecutor shall take it in advisement. Clerk is directed to kindly call and situate to the witness stand, Attorney Kathy Florence M. Baldonado.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk is directed to administer the oath.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Ma'am, please raise your right hand. You, Cathy Florence M. Baldonado, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help me God.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Cathy, naunawaan niyo po ang inyong pinanumpaan kaugnay ng pagbigay niyo ng inyong testimonya ngayong umaga sa hukuman ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Salamat po. Kindly make your offer, Honorable Keith.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Your Honor, the testimony of this witness is offered to prove the following. Number one, that the witness is the Register of Deeds of Davao City. Number two, that based on official records, there is a property covering 379 square meters in Barangay Matina, Davao City, registered under the name of Attorney Manases Carpio, married to Vice President Sara Duterte. Number three, that based on the deed of sale in the official record of the Register of Deeds, the property was purchased at 6 million pesos. 4. Until today,

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: the

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: property remains to be registered in the name of Atty. Manases Carpio, married to Vice President Sara Duterte, according to the official record of the Registry of Deeds. 5. All other matters relevant to Article 2 on unexplained wealth, false SALNs, and continued business interests. This witness, Your Honor, is one of the several prosecution witnesses who will establish that there were undeclared properties with the Vice President.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Pero sa ordinaryang Pilipino po, malaking halaga na to ang 6 million pesos.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Good morning.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It is our position that the testimony of Atty. Baldonado is irrelevant, Your Honor, considering that in the articles of impeachment, there's no specific allegation as regards any particular real property which was not... Allegedly not disclosed in any of the SALN of the Vice President, Your Honor. As recently ruled by this honorable court, the impeachment is highly penal in character and thus the Bill of Rights apply in all stages of the proceedings. Without any specific allegations in the articles of impeachment, the presentation of The testimony of a witness would violate the respondent's right to be informed of the nature and cause of the allegations against him, Your Honor. Nonetheless, all the purposes are subject to cross-examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Brief rejoinder, Honorable Keith.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, we clearly mentioned in Article 2, particularly Paragraph B of the Articles of Impeachment, Your Honor, that one of the allegations is that the Vice President failed to disclose in her SALN all of her properties, Your Honor, and that it was impossible for us to have known of this property simply because it was not disclosed in the SALN, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: If I may, Your Honor, a brief rejoinder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Brief rejoinder, Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, the particular portion referred to by the prosecution are mere conclusions, Your Honor, particularly because in the articles of impeachment, the reference was only made to salaries, alleged business interests, and alleged suspicious and covert transactions, Your Honor, without mentioning any particular real property, Your Honor. So it is our position that the testimony of Atty. Baldonado would be irrelevant, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The objection on relevance of Atty. Lindon is duly noted and will likewise note the continuing objection after the Court makes a ruling allowing the testimony of this witness given that the prosecution is not bound to so attach in its complaint or impeachment complaint any and all pieces of evidence it shall be presenting to prove. This particular article on ill-gotten or unexplained wealth. Would you like to note your continuing objection, Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: We do, Your Honor. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So noted. Atty. Keith, Hon. Keith, you may proceed with your witness.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Atty. Baldonado, can you please state your full name and your position for the record?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ako po si Atty. Cathy Florence Baldonado, ang kasalukuyang Register of Deeds ng Davao City po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: What is the mandate of the Register of Deeds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ako po bilang Register of Deeds ay nagre-rehistro o nagtatala po ng mga instrumento, mga dokumento po, or kasulatan regarding po ng mga real properties, particularly ang lupa po. At kami po yung nag-i-issue ng katibayan ng titulo at kami din po yung mga nagsi-safekeep or nagtatago ng mga records kaugnay dito po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Can you tell us why you're here today, Atty. Baldonado?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Nakatanggap po ako ng subpoena po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: And ano naman po ang sinabi ng subpoena na natanggap niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ang subpoena ko po ay maging witness ngayong araw na ito at meron din pong pinadala sa aking mga dokumento po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Sa naaalala ko po, ang hinihingi po ay isang certified true copy at tatlong USB drive ng mga dokumentong hawak ko po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Ano po yung mga dokumento specifically na dala ninyo ngayon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: If I may, Your Honor, pwede ko pong tingnan isa-isa yung aking...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ang certified true copy po ng Transfer Certificate of Title Bilang 146-2024-010775.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ang deed of sale,

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: real property tax clearance,

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: official receipt ng transfer tax, certification, tax on transfer of real property ownership, ang tax declaration ng land at ng building nito. At ang e-car, pati na rin po itong nakanselang titulo kung saan ang galing itong transfer certificate of title number 146-2024010775.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, may we ask for copies of the documents brought by the witness?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes. Attorney, Atty. Cathy, yung USB po niyong dala, yung po ang naglalaman, yung mga dokumentong binanggit ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung hard copy po, yan yung certified true copy?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Can you turn over please the USB so that tatlo po ang dala po ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. At yung isa po ay naibigay ko na po kanina po sa Clerk of Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We will be printing it. Clerk of Court is directed to print the same and immediately furnish a copy to the Counsel for Respondent as well as to the Court. And in the meantime, Attorney Cathy, can you give one copy of the USB to the Counsel for the Respondent, Assistant Counsel for Respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So that they may start perusing it already through their laptop. as well as one USB for the counsel for the panel of prosecutors.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: And the documents, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Let the documents stay with her so that she can refer to it whenever necessary. You can refer to it, counsel, through perhaps a laptop.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But we are having the documents photocopied already.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Actually, we're giving copies to both parties now.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Both parties?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay, you may proceed, Honorable Keith.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: May we request our assisting counsel, Attorney Hester, to bring the USB to the tech booth so

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: that

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: we could flash the documents?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel may do so. Likewise, continuing authority for assisting counsel of both parties is given throughout the testimony of Attorney Cathy.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: May I proceed, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Honorable Keith.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Atty. Baldonado, you mentioned earlier that the copies that you brought were certified true copies. How would you know that these are certified true copies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ito pong dala ko ay isang certified true copy. Malalaman po natin ito dahil ito po ay espesyal na papel, sir. Tapos, meron po itong mga security features. Ito po ay eksklusibong ini-issue po ng Land Registration Authority. Meron po itong mga QR code. Halimbawa na po, meron siyang QR code sa itaas at kanang bahagi ng certified true copy. Meron din po itong serial number at barcode sa ilalim na kaliwang bahagi po ng dokumento at meron din po itong mga watermark, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: this point, may we ask that

turns.text: Your Honor. Since we are concluding early for our morning trial, I would like to proceed to our manifestation which we are supposed to make after lunch, Your Honor, if the court will allow.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, after lunch. Ah, you want to do it now?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may do so. We're early anyway. The food

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: might not be available

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: yet.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. First, Your Honor, the prosecution has finally decided not to present former Senator Sonny Trillanes. We seek the kind indulgence of the Honorable Impeachment Court for the belated final position on this particular concern. Second, Your Honor, pursuant to the directive of the Honorable Impeachment Court, we are respectfully submitting The order of presentation of witnesses as follows. For October 2, Friday, that is tomorrow, Your Honor, we anticipate the continuation of presentation of the AMLC Executive Director. We lament, Your Honor, that we have no other witness to be presented tomorrow. Thus, we will be constrained to move for the deferment of presentation. Should the AMLC Executive Director conclude early his presentation on Friday?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So we only have one witness for tomorrow and if at all that will be the continuation of the testimony of the AMLC Director.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor. To continue, Your Honor, for Monday, October 5, we will be presenting the BIR and for Tuesday, October 6, we will be presenting the representatives of banks and insurance companies. And it is in this light, Your Honor, that we respectfully reiterate our request for issuance of subpoena to BIR as well as the representatives of banks and insurance companies.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Number 3, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Insofar as the banks are concerned, do you have a sequence already, Honorable Luistro? You have here seven banks. Is it, will it be as it appears in your request for subpoena?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We intend, Your Honor, to present them on Tuesday. On Monday, Monday

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: or Tuesday, I guess.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Tuesday, Your Honor, or Monday, if the BIR will conclude early.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: In the same order, Your Honor, as mentioned in the request, Your Honor. So,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: for the record and for the information of counsel-respondent, the order shall be after AMLC, BIR, on Monday. And then, insofar as the banks are concerned, Land Bank, Asia United Bank, Philippine Savings Bank, Metro Bank, BPI, PNB, and finally, BDO.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And for the insurance companies, Honorable Luistro, also in the same order that they appear in your request for subpoena?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We confirm, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So for the record, that will be Prudential Life, Allianz,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Manufacturers Life, FWD Life, BPI-AIA Life, BDO Securities, and BDO Life. In that order. Would that be correct, Honorable Luistro?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Chair, hereby grants the request for the issuance of subpoena, duces tecum, and ad testificandum to the BIR as well as the banks and insurance companies named In the request for subpoena with a caveat or change that it shall be for Monday and Tuesday, October 5 and 6.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: To be certain that we have enough time for all of these. So ordered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Attorney Sheila is recognized before the Honorable Senator Judge Sotto.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Just the two items. Just to clarify,

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Will the prosecution no longer present the former Senator Trillanes completely? Which means that they will no longer or they have removed him from their list of witness or are they just deferring on the presentation of the former Senator?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Luistro?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: As manifested already, Your Honor, we will no longer be presenting the former Senator Sonny Trillanes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: So they will now drop this particular witness, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Effectively, yes, Attorney Sheila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: second item, Your Honor, may we also ask the prosecution if they can provide us copies of any summaries or other documents that the witnesses for the Insurance Commission and BIR as well as the banks. Would identify so that we'll have ample time to examine them. Based

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: on the earlier ruling of the court, yes, the court will grant that request of Attorney Sheila, kindly furnished as you did with AMLC, Honorable Luistro. We

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: submit, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Any summaries that the witnesses may present during their testimony ahead of time.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We submit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Senator-Judge Sotto is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer, Mr. President. Thank you. Just some trivia questions for Attorney Pineda, if you don't mind. Anyway, we have time.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please. You may proceed, Senator Judge Sotto. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Your Register of Deeds of the Island Garden City of Samal.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Your Honor, I am merely the Acting Register of Deeds of the Island Garden City.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Acting Register of Deeds. How long have you been in the Samal City?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Four years, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Four years only? So in 1998, you were not in Samal?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No, sir. No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Did you know that Samal City used to have three municipalities and no city?

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: You did not know that, no?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: I did not know that, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Anyway, the island of Samal used to be three municipalities.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: It was converted into one city after convincing the three mayors and all the register of deeds people then to make it into one island garden city of Samal in 1998. Just as I said, it's just a trivia. Did you know who made the city of island garden of city of Samal?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No. I

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: think it's one

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Senator Tito Sotto, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: You're correct. Thank you. I have no more questions, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Following the footsteps of Senator-Judge Sotto, Sorsogon did the same thing. We merged two towns to form the city of Sorsogon and we relied on the Supreme Court decision in the island city of Samal that said that you can actually merge and create at the same time in one law. and that it will not violate the one subject matter that should be contained in the Title Rule found in the Constitution. And both laws were declared constitutional by the Supreme Court. So anyway, we shall pause for lunch. We shall resume at 12.30 with the first witness earlier presented, Attorney Baldonado of the City of Davao. You are excused and kindly partake of lunch. Atty. Marco.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Trial is in recess.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly situate Atty. Cathy to the witness stand.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The clerk of court through the sergeant at arms is so directed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm assuming you have a cross right, Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi kasi kung wala, hindi ko na papaupuin si Atty. Cathy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Cathy, naunawaan niyo po na patuloy kayong tetestigo basis sa nauna po niyong pinanumpaan kaninang umaga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly answer, ma'am, so that we can have it on record.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon, your witness. You may proceed with your cross when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Good afternoon, ma'am. Good

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: afternoon, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ma'am, you are a lawyer, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And you are also the Register of Deeds for Davao City?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And you are testifying here in that capacity, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The Registry of Deeds is the public repository of records or instruments affecting registered lands, tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It has also the duty to immediately register an instrument for registration dealing with real property, tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Provided po na na-comply nila lahat ng requirements for

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Being

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: the public repository of records of lands, ma'am, The title you identified is public correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And anyone can request for a copy of that title?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The requesting person does not need to be the owner of that property correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: He does not need to have an interest over that property correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You are also aware that before a title may be transferred to another person or may be issued

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: He or she must submit a certificate authorizing registration regarding payment of transfer taxes from the Bureau of Internal Revenue, real property tax clearance from the local government unit concerned, and proof of payment of transfer taxes. Correct ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes po, tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: These are the requirements so that your office knows that the proper taxes have been paid. Correct ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And you would not transfer a title or issue a title without submission of these requirements, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. And in the title you identified, it was issued to Manassas R. Carpio, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes po, base po sa aming record.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. The Registry of Deeds, ma'am, is not the repository of SALNs of any public official or employee, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. So you would not have any personal knowledge on the listed assets in any of the SALNs of the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You would not have any personal knowledge on the listed liabilities in any of the SALNs of the Vice President. Tama po? You would not have any personal knowledge on the listed net worth in any of the Vice President SALNs. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. You would also not have any personal knowledge on the financial and business interests listed in any of the Vice President SALNs.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Of

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: course, yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You would not know if any of the Vice President SALNs Need any correction, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Of course, yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: you cannot testify on the completeness or incompleteness of the disclosure in the SALN because you have no personal knowledge. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yung title po na in-identify niyo kanina, ito po, issued noong July 26, 2024. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo, base po sa aming record. July 26, 2024.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Tapos yung parcel of land na naka-describe po dyan sa property is nakalagay located in Matina, Davao City. Tama po ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Gano'n na po kayo katagal na register of deeds sa Davao City?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Mahigit isang taon na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. So you would know ma'am na ang Matina Crossing is also known as Barangay 748. Alam niyo po yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: In that light, Your Honor, may we just reiterate our earlier manifestation that this honorable court can take mandatory judicial notice of the geographical divisions in the Philippines, particularly that Matina Crossing is also known or officially known as Paranggay 748, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, we'd like to make a counter-manifestation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm sorry, Attorney John?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: We'd like to make a counter-manifestation also. Kindly

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: do so. Your

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Honor, Matina is a general area and it comprises of several barangays, Your Honor. So, we'd just like to put that

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: on record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The court will look into it with the permission of Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Understood, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I'm showing you tax declarations pertaining to the transfer certificate of title which you identified.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Do you have two... Tax declarations, ma'am. Dalawa po yung hawak nyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yung ibinigay po? Opo. Ito po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You would confirm, ma'am, that the tax declarations na hawak mo pertain to the same TCT number.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Pareho ba ito ng record namin, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Nakalagay po dyan yung TCT number. You may refer to it, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: May we know, Your Honor, if this is a separate document from that which was produced by the witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It is a separate document, Your Honor. It is the more recent tax declaration, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So you're showing the witness a tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Then we will be

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: objecting, Your Honor, to any question related to this particular document. Because this is not one of the documents that was presented by... The witness in this fact a document that has not been identified nor authenticated by any witness whatsoever, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, with due respect to the prosecution, the cross covers any relevant matter. And since the witness identified a particular TCT, then we can confront her with documents related to that particular title, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, that tax declaration...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, rebuttal from Attorney John.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Sorry, Your Honor. That tax declaration did not come with the documents presented by the witness, Your Honor. Therefore, she could not be confronted with that document, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: If

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: they want to present that tax declaration, Your Honor, they should present their own witness who will be able to identify and authenticate that tax declaration, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, a short rejoinder, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Final rejoinder, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Aside from covering relevant matters, Your Honor, cross-examination also covers all facts bearing an important, bearing significance in the case, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: So this is, we submit, this is an important fact which can be elicited.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the indulgence of Attorney John, the court will allow it, proper subject matter for cross, to confront the witness with this document, if she knows, of course.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: May we ask to inspect first the document, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: May you ask for a copy?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You have assisting counsel there to look at the copy?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Do you have an extra copy, Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, we do.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Can you confront the witness with that extra copy while the prosecution is perusing the document so that you may proceed with your cross-examination?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Can you proceed, Atty. Cathy? You were asked, yung tax declaration po ba na yan ay tumutugma o ang tinutukoy ay yung TCT na binanggit niyo kanina?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Makikita niyo po sa tax declaration, typical na tax declaration sa registradong lupa, yung TCT number sa bandang kaliwang bahagi.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we just request the tech, your honor, to flash the tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly flash it on the screen, please. The clerk of court and the tech is so directed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Yes, sir. Base po dito sa ibinigay niyong dokumento, ang nakalagay po na TCT. ay 146-2024010-775 na nagtutugma po sa titolong naka-certify po sa aming records.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Just to clarify ma'am, yung hawak niyo pong tax declaration pertains to tax declaration over the land and tax declaration over the building, tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. Ma'am, do you confirm that the declared market value of the land is 1,864,680 pesos?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: We object, Your Honor. Again, the witness is incompetent to testify on the matter, Your Honor. They should be presenting the city assessor, Your Honor, who will be testifying on that tax declaration.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: She's being asked only as to the contents of the document, not as to the accuracy or truth of the same. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Tama ma'am. Ang nakalagay na declared market value ng land is 1,864,680 pesos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: Ipagpaumanin niyo po sir. Ang akin po is hindi po ito nagagaling sa aming record so hindi po ako maka... Kung ipapabasa niyo lang

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: po

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: sa

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: akin

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
turns.text: kung ano yung nakikita ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, as appearing in the document.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, she already answered that she's incompetent to testify.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What was her answer, Attorney Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Based on the record, what you read in the document anyway?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, the witness agreed to confirm the contents of the tax declaration. We confronted her by reading the same, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: The witness likewise manifested, Your Honor, that she is incompetent to testify on this matter.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But the witness may read what the document is stating in front of her. Just to get over this, Attorney,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kathy, kindly read what is the market value contained in the tax declaration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Cathy Florence M. Baldonado
