turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes sir as it appears in the records.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: So they declared na nabili na nila ang property in 2013 yet

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: ang actual deed of sale Ay ginawa noong 2018, 5 years after. Ano ba ang penalty for perjury or for making a...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Relevance

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: and competence, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Unless you have any other questions, Atty. John?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Last question, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No, no, no more questions, Sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Any recourse, Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: A few questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, as Register of Deeds, malamang familiar po kayo sa dealings with real property, tama po? Yung mga kontrata involving real property, familiar po kayo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: So, time and again, we encountered the documents required pertinent to a specific transaction.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And nabanggit nyo rin po kanina na na-abogado kayo. So, familiar po kayo kung papaano binibenta ang isang lupa, diba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: So,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: it is usual po na bago mabayaran ng...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Bago mabayaran ng kabuoan ng hinihingi ng purchase price sa lupa, nag-execute po na ng contract to sell ang mga partido. Tama po? In your experience?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: witness knows, kung alam nyo po, Atty. Margo, kung hindi po, sabihin nyo rin po kung hindi nyo po alam.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Can I repeat my question, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, you may, Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Are

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: you aware po na it is usually...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It is usual that before the entire purchase price is paid, a contract to sell is executed between the parties.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: In

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: a purely academic fashion, sir, with all due respect to this honorable court, a contract begins with a consent, object and consideration. If the parties have a meeting of minds, They can sell lands orally but that would not bind the world. It is the registration of the land that binds the whole world as a constructive notice.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But it is binding us within the parties, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And sa pagbebenta po ng lupa, kapag nakabayad na yung buyer ng buong purchase price, doon pa lang itatransfer yung pangalan sa titulo. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: As I've said sir, with all your respect to the Honorable Court, we have a system that pops out the documentary requirements. So it requires more than just the deed of sale or the deed of conveyance. It requires the payment of the tax, the ECAR, the capital gains tax.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay, sige sir. Nabanggit nyo rin po yan. So yun pong nakalagay na purchase price. Aside from the purchase price, every sale of property nagbabayad din ng transfer tax. Tama po sir?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: It's already been

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: asked and answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It's for the earlier witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That was

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: an earlier witness. He was merely mentioning the documentary requirements that the Register of Deeds require to be submitted before they issue a new title in favor of the buyer. Witness may answer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I'll repeat my question, sir. So aside from the purchase price, nagbabayad rin yung mga parties ng transfer tax, tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For the Senator's interjections, we have Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Just a point of clarification lamang po to the defense. Are you saying that the subject properties are all stated in the SALN of the Vice President? Kasi it seems to me that the prosecution is saying that the subject properties were not declared. Pakiclarify lang.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: That is the position of... Our position, Your Honor, that the properties that the two witnesses testified to today are in fact declared in the SALN of the Vice President, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright, thank you, Mr. Defense Attorney.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Dito po tayo sa ati pong witness. Mr. Witness, does the registry of these possess any corporate records, bank trails, or financial documents indicating? Public funds or personal funds belonging strictly to Vice President Sara were utilized to purchase these properties. Sir, do you have those?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No, sir, because as I said, sir, with all due respect, we have a set of requirements, documentary requirements. So, we just adhere to what is required of us as ministerial officers. We don't have any paper trail on the source of the funds.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. May susunod ko po ng question. As an official of the LRA, sir, meron ba kayong personal knowledge regarding sa marital property regime? Example, sir, mga absolute community or complete separation of property, yung establishment between the spouses bago po sila nag-asawa, baka meron ng lupa si Atty. Man Scarpio, magkahiwalay sila ng property?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So, wala ho kayong ganon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright. Then, let me move to my next question, sir. Sir,

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: if a public official declares a real estate in their SAL-N, tapos using a broad geographical classification, alright, a developer's project name or an aggregate real property without explicitly writing the words Barangay Matano-Samal, for example,

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Your automated title lookup would register that as a no matching record? Correct? Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: If

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: my recollection serves me right, Your Honor, that would be the output or the outcome.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. So, the standard SALN format provided by the Civil Service Commission does not strictly require public official to itemize the exact lot. and block number of the micro barangay address of every single parcel. That's it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, sir, but I have some reservations, Your Honor, considering that under the law, Republic Act 6713, the official custodian of the SALN is the office of the Ombudsman. So I have some reservations, Your Honor, because I might be saying something that... and I will be violating the law as a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So you're saying na parang hindi kayo sigurado?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, sir, as a matter of mandate, the mandate for office, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: No further questions, Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Erwin. The Senate President is recognized. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you. Thank you. Good afternoon sa ating witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Itong, again, tinitignan ko itong TCT. Anong exact barangay itong property na ito? According to the TCT. Mr. Pineda.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Kagalanggalang na Pangulo. Hingi pa ako ng kuting oras, tinitignan ko po muna.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ano yung exact barangay niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Ang nakasulat po rito sa mukha ng mismong titulo ay, and I read, Kagalanggalang na Pangulo. It is hereby certified. that certain land situated in Matanos Island Garden City of Samal, province of the Baldo-Norte Philippines. Yan po ang nakasulat, end of quote, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So ang barangay nito ay Matanos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yan ang official barangay nitong property, itong TCT ending 3134?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: As appearing in the document, yes, kagalang-galang na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Tingin-tingin ko rin yung kanina na point out ng defense lawyers. Meron ding barangay San Isidro? Merong barangay San Isidro?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Meron po, kagalang-galang na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Nagpareho ba yun yung San Isidro at barangay Matanos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Magkaiba siya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kasi dito sa tinitignan ko yung SAL-N, merong ring barangay San Isidro particularly. So magkaibang barangay ito. Hindi siya nag-rename o hindi naging isang barangay. Magkaiba siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Kakalanggalang at mahal na Pangulo, kung hayaan niyo po akong ihayag kung paano po nangyayari ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Sige po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Salamat po. Ganito po kasi yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kasi

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: tinitignan ko itong SAL-N dated...

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: 2018 may Barangay San Isidro pero doon sa titulo Barangay Matanos. So magkaiba siya. Magkaiba.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Opo, mahal na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Very clear yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Ganito po kasi yan. Kung mayroong malaking lupa na gusto pong bilhin ng isang malaking developer, bibilhin po niya. At saka ito po ay sumasaklaw ng maraming barangay. At kung ito pong barangay ay nakaugat sa dating kadastri po, Ang trabaho po ng isang Register of Deeds ay purely ministerial. Isa'y automaticong pagganap ng tungkulin na walang pagpapasya. Kinukopya po namin yan. Kine-carry over namin yung dating titulo, yung tinatawag na mother title, yung ina. At ipapasok po namin yan sa derivative title, yung anak na titulo. Kaya kung ang dati pong pinagugatan ng titulo ay nakasulat po sa buka nito ay matanos, carried over po yan. Dadalin po yan ng anak yung derivative title. Ito po ang nangyari kadalasan po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay, pero for this purpose, itong lupang ito, nasa barangay Matano siya, hindi sa barangay San Isidro. Yun ang gusto natin malaman.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Napakaganda po ng tanong po ninyo, mahal na Pangulo. Kasi po ganito yan, kung gusto nyo talagang matiyak kung saan ang lupa na binili at nakalagay sa titulo, kailangan po natin yung recent tax mapping. At ang recent tax mapping po ay matatagpuan sa tax declaration.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So ano po yung nakalagay sa tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Hayaan niyo po akong basahin po, mahal na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Go ahead po, go ahead.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Batay po, mahal na Pangulo, sa tax declaration of real property na hinawakan ko po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Ang nakasulat po rito ay, location of property, and I quote, San Isidro, Kaputian, District Igakos, end of quote. Yun po ang recent latest tax mapping ng City Assessor ng Samal po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So hindi po sa Matanos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Kaya po. Kasi po yung po ang dati pong kadastre. Ayon po sa Section 108 ng Presidential Decree 1529 or the Property Registration Decree, we are not authorized to change or alter any entries in the title unless there is a court order po or order from the Registration Authority.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: So kung wala po, we will just carry that over to the succeeding titles or the derivative titles po. If you want to know the exact place po ng property, we have to go to the recent tax mapping based on the tax declaration po. Mahal na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. And then, base po sa inyong karanasan, kasi nakikinig ako kanina sa inyong mga sagot, dito ba sa Samal ay, base sa inyong karanasan, dahil five years na kayo doon, ang presyo ba ng lupa, tumataas o bumaba ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Hindi ko po saklaw na aking mandato po, yun po rin sa assessor po. Pero tumataas po based on public knowledge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kasi nung tinitignan ko yung acquisition cost, 4 million, pero doon sa deed of sale, kanina pinapoint out ang defense, 4 million yung acquisition cost, pero ang deed of sale is 3.4 million in 2018, so bumaba siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Posible ba yun kung talagang one and the same property yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Mahal na pagulo, as it appears in the records po, opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kung one and the same property yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero may ganyan bang pangyayari dyan sa area? I think Kimbali ang tawag dyan sa area na yan. Bumaba ba ang presyo ng lupa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Tatapatin ko po kayo mahal na Pangulo. Hindi pa po ako nakapunta sa Kimbali coast po. Pero sa pagkakaalam ko po, tumataas po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ang presyo dyan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: That's my personal opinion lang po. Hindi po yung legal na opinion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dahil matagal na kayo dyan eh. So nakikita niyo yung transactions dahil kayo ang register of deeds, nakikita niyo yung transfer ng... At least meron kayong gut feel ang takbuhan ng presyo dyan sa area.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes po mahal na Pangulo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, thank you Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Senate President. Senator Judge Villanueva is recognized for his interjections. You have two minutes sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ah yes, Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Would you respect your honor, we would just like to, in light of the interjection of... The Senate President, we would just like to clarify that while the acquisition cost is constant, the declared property from 2013 to until present reflects the increase in assessed and market value, Your Honor. But

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: the SALN merely requires the declarant to write the acquisition cost, not the market value.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, may we also make a counter-manifestation since he was allowed?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Attorney John, in light of the manifestation of Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Your Honor, it's also worthy to note that this property subject matter of the title, Your Honor, is in Kembali Resort. It's an exclusive resort subdivision, Your Honor. So the price does not go down, it goes up.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Noted, counsel, but that did not come from the witness. Same is true with the manifestation of Attorney Lindon. Senator-Judge Villanueva, you may proceed, sir. You have 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yes, Mr. President. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. I will no longer ask questions because I think I'm interested again in asking the same question and I already know the answer. would be the same. So again, let me just put into the records as mentioned earlier that this court needs evidence tracing who actually paid for this property and where the funds came from and we need probably Mr. President, seller's payment, records, loan disbursement records and if loan is being relied on and bank or AMLC records specifically linked to this acquisition. This will help definitely establish how this transaction supports the allegations under Article 2. So, I hope, Mr. President, that we can proceed now to the next witness. Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Villanueva. If there are no other Senator-Judges who wishes to make an interjection, the Chair will wind it up. Mr. Attorney... Pinela.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: May I ask, ang nakalagay po sa titlo, hindi ba technical description lamang ng lupa at hindi address? Kunwari, ang bahay po namin sa probinsya, kilometer 584, Maharlika Highway, Barangay Buhatan, Sorsogon City, Province of Sorsogon, wala pong address sa titlo, di po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Meron po yung under the registered owners po na caption.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung address po ng may-ari pero hindi po yung address nung lupaing binibili subject matter of the TCT.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Meron lang po yung caption sa itaas po kung saan na situated po, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nakalagay nga lang po yung address nung registered owner.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Hindi po yung pinakauna po yung parang preface niya. It is hereby certified that certain land situated in Matanos.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kaya yung barangay po nakalagay pero hindi po address nga talaga. May numero at may kalye.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Tumpak po yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Wala pa po kayong nakitang titolo, TCT man o OCT, na nakalagay na description ng lupa, yung actual na street number and street name plus barangay and city.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Tama po yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ang mababasa po lamang ay technical description.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ibig sabihin, from a point beginning 1-2 on the northeast, x meters, x degrees, hindi po ba ganun lang?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Sangayon po ako dun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kaya nga kailangan po ng surveyor para tiyakin na yung technical description sa titulo, yun nga ay tumutugma sa lupa yung binili ninyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Opo, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, hindi po ganung kadali na imatch yung address, kung may street address man yung bahay na binili, kung bahay man po yun, dito sa titulo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Tama po yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Isa pa pong tanong.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In the SALN of the Vice President in 2015 and 2016 and 2017, she declared a property in Icagos stating that she bought a property in 2013 but it first appeared only in her SALN in 2015 and then she wrote installment in 2015 as pointed out by the Senate.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Installment in 2015, Deferred Installment in 2016, which she described as Deferred Installment again in 2017, and in 2018 declared it as a sale. So, posible po ba na sale

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: on installment itong lupa ang pinag-uusapan natin at dineklara lamang nung fully paid na ito? Is that possible if you know, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Apologies, Your Honor. I have no personal knowledge, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pero nakakita na kayo ng mga dupain, Atty. Marco, na binibenta on installment sale.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Meron po yung sa gobyerno po yung sa National Housing Finance Corporation. Meron pong ganun na pautang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ito na lang po. Will you register a contract to sell? In the register of deeds and transfer ownership to the buyer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: No sir, it is your honor, it is merely an annotation to the title.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So it is only a deed of sale that you will register, if at all, in the register of deeds as evidence of transfer of real estate property?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Yes, your honor. Those which are simply contracts to sell or conditional sale, we may annotate that as part of the incumbrances but there is no transfer so the title remains in the name of the original. Registered owner po, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That is perhaps one thing for the civil service to look at dahil ang dinedeklara po sa SAL-N ay general description lamang ng real property at hindi po ganung kadali, para din sa kaalaman ng ating mga manonood at viewing public, hindi po ganung kasimplang ipagtugma yung aktual na lupain o lugar dun sa dineklara sa SAL-N at dun sa nasa titulo dahil magkakaiba po ang nilalaman po nun. Tama po ba yun, Atty. Marco?

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: Tama po yun, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much. If there are no other senator-judges who wishes to make interjections, we shall dispense with this witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Marco, maraming salamat po sa inyong panahon, pasensya, at pagtugon-pagsagot sa mga katanungan ng abogado ng magkabilang partido, gayon din ng ilang senator-judges. You are excused, sir, and thank you very much.

turns.speaker: Atty. Marco K. Pineda
turns.text: The honor is all mine, Your Honor. Thank you po. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Chair declares a brief recess upon the request of the parties for a sidebar before we call on the next witness. The next witness, Attorney John, is the AMLAC representative or head, correct?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. The next witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Chair declares a brief recess of 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For your record, the chair called for a brief recess upon the request of council correspondent for a sidebar where we discussed some matters pertaining to the next witness, particularly some provisions in the AMLC Law 9-160 as amended, which the chair during the recess brought up in caucus. and inform the senators to take it, senator-judges to take the same under-advisement for the matter to be decided upon when trial resumes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Also, Attorney Sheila kindly confirmed, during the sidebar, can you be the one, Attorney Sheila? Attorney Sheila also raised some...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Concerns given the voluminous documents that the AMLC will be presenting, best to come from your own words, Attorney Sheila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: That's correct, Your Honor. Thank you. I confirm that we raised some concerns after perusal of the summaries that were mentioned by the lead prosecutor earlier this morning. I also would like just to correct the record that

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Actually, we're able to receive this through our office email at 9.34 a.m. but this was only forwarded to us at 11.28 a.m. and we were only able to see these during the lunch break. But going back to our concern, we just noticed that this document consists or the summaries including the cover letter submitted by Executive Director of the Secretariat of the Anti-Money Laundering Council, Atty. Ronel Buenaventura, consisting of 11 pages, actually has on each and every page of this document a strictly confidential mark. And this repeats in the entire submission including the accompanying summaries. identified as Annex A, and so on and so forth. There is also a portion in the cover letter dated October 1, 2026 of the Executive Director of AMLC addressed to the lead of the panel of the prosecutors explicitly saying that the AMLC is not waiving the confidentiality of AMLC records. Now, in view of that, and Section 8-A of AMLA as amended by Republic Act No. 11521 and as well as the fact that we just received copies of these summaries today. which now will involve an undertaking of a review of at least 23 to 24 boxes of documents on the part of the defense. And without a review of that, we cannot imagine how we would be able to intelligently respond to the questioning of the prosecution to their intended witness should it come to that. And raise the proper grounds, therefore, without examination of the documents that we need to do to appreciate the so-called summaries here, in addition, of course, to our objection that we may raise on the confidentiality, absolute confidentiality of these records. And we note, Your Honor, that when this court ruled to grant the request for subpoena of the prosecution in July 20, 2026, I think the limitation of that ruling was only on the issuance of the subpoena. And the court had made clear that that ruling is without prejudice to the eventual objection at the proper time that will come from the respondent. Also, in the journal that we had reviewed on that ruling, it cited the case of Republic v. Sandiganbayan to justify the grant of the request for subpoena. But we would note that that case was decided at the time when the amendatory law, Republic Act No. 11521, was not yet in effect. And the facts of the case obtaining were under the old law, before the passage of the old law, providing for the absolute confidentiality of the AMLC records. Just those for now, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: out of an abundance of caution, as used by Attorney Sheila also last week, Ex-Abundante Gautela furnished the Senator-Judges with a copy of the provisions of the law raised by the Council of Respondents, again, for their perusal and for them to study before we make an intelligent judgment on the matter when we resume. Kaugnay nung isa po niyong sinabi, Atty. Sheila, sa madali salita, kailangan niyo pa ng panahon para maghandaan at maghanda. Para sa cross-examination at kung sakasakali kahandaan din na mag-object sa direct examination kung may mga punto mang dapat objectan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor, but not only to time to prepare for the cross-examination and to object to the direct examination, but as well as to offer a proper comment to the offer of the testimonial evidence.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And during the recess, during the sidebar, Atty. Sheila, do you also confirm that you requested for Monday to do this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Not exactly a request, Your Honor, but I think that schedule was considered earlier.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The subpoenas to be issued were only given now. We will be issuing the subpoenas for the respective banks and insurance companies today. Hence, it would be too late to serve them for any witness to be presented tomorrow because originally we were planning to spend this afternoon and tomorrow for AMLC for both parties as well as the senator-judges. Hence, there will be no available witness tomorrow through no fault of the prosecution. And given that, we will be expecting the other witnesses to appear on Monday. Monday it shall be for us to continue with this trial. Honorable Diokno is recognized. You seem to be indicating that you wish to talk. Yes, Honorable

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Diokno.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. I did not want to interrupt the Honorable Presiding Officer. If I may be allowed to respond to some of the Statements made by the defense counsel. First of all, Your Honor, the records will bear me out that the documents of the Anti-Money Laundering Council were provided to the defense way back in September 2. That is, I believe, enough time for them to have produced the documents and prepared for the presentation of the... Witness from the AMLC. Second, if your honor please, this matter was actually resolved directly by this honorable court on July 20, 2026 and I did not hear the defense counsel address this particular portion of the ruling of this court which I may be allowed to read if I may. I quote, The defense vigorously argues that the AMLC is absolutely shielded from this court's compulsory process by the confidentiality provisions of Section 80 of the Anti-Money Laundering Act as amended and warrants that compliance with exposed AMLC officers to criminal sanctions for breach of confidentiality. The court, however, finds this argument unavailing. Section 8-A, this is referring to the Anti-Money Laundering Law, Regulates unauthorized and arbitrary disclosures by AMLC personnel. It does not and constitutionally cannot nullify the lawful subpoena powers of the Senate sitting as an impeachment court where compliance with the lawful constitutional subpoena is a justifying circumstance that if at all would extinguish any penal liability under Article 11, Paragraph 6 of the Revised Penal Code for any person acting in obedience to an order issued by a superior or some other lawful purpose. And I believe, Your Honor, that that ruling still stands. Neither the prosecution or the defense has any standing under the rules to move for its reconsideration. If ever, only an honorable member of this court may do so. And Your Honor, in that respect, the statements of the defense are really in the nature of a motion for reconsideration, which as I said, is not allowed. Now, if we were to address the substance of the arguments, may I simply say, and I believe I have said this before, that Section 8-A was only intended to prevent leaks by officers or employees. of the Anti-Money Laundering Council. It was never intended as a blanket shield for any lawful subpoenas issued by a proper court. In fact, very often, I remember also saying this before that the Sandigan Bayan has issued subpoenas to the Anti-Money Laundering Council and they have appeared before that court and brought documents despite the existence of Section 8A. I see no difference

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Between this Honorable Court exercising its subpoena power and in fact its power to try and decide this case given directly by the Constitution is even more impelling and compelling than a subpoena issued by the Sandiganbayan in the course of its exercise of its jurisdiction. Therefore, if Your Honors please, we respectfully submit that we put our witness on the stand. We proceed with the direct examination. If there are any objections to the offer or to any specific questions, of course, the defense, we would gladly hear them and argue with them about it. But I believe we should move forward already with the presentation of this witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: The gentleman quoted, and I will quote. The same portion of the journal dated July 20, 2026 that the Honorable Congressman Diokno read. It says here, The defense vigorously argues that the AMLC is absolutely shielded from this court's compulsory process by the confidentiality provisions of Section 8 of the Anti-Money Laundering Act as amended and warrants that compliance with exposed AMLC officers to criminal sanctions for breach of confidentiality. However, I think it may have escaped the attention of the gentleman the following paragraph. It says here, The court, however, finds this argument unavailing. Section 8-A regulates unauthorized and arbitrary disclosures by AMLC personnel. It does not and constitutionally cannot nullify the lawful subpoena powers of the Senate sitting as an impeachment court where compliance with the lawful constitutional

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: subpoena and to be continued.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: So in other words, even this court as early as July 20, 2026 had recognized that there is absolute confidentiality involving AMLC personnel and the witness about to be presented by the prosecution today is undeniably Not only at AMLC personnel, but the Executive Director of its Secretariat, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: That's my short rebuttal, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Just one brief, one sentence response.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: One sentence, sir, rebuttal. Good, sir. Yes, Honorable Diokno.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Your Honor, if the Court, as claimed by the Defense Counsel, recognized the absolute confidentiality, then why did it issue this subpoena in the first place? That's all, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The court will make a ruling.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Senator-Judge Sotto is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: I am not aware of what the presiding officer's ruling would be, but I have very strong reservations about postponing any proceedings this afternoon because all this time I am... I've thought that the prosecution and the defense have been ready with this since July, since the time we took an oath. Talab na nila kung ano yung mga parating eh. Di ba? So I don't think many would enjoy a postponement only because they were not given proper time. This was since July. And I understand September 2 being in the defense. I'm speaking for the public, Mr. Presiding Officer, Your Honor. So I leave it to you and my colleagues, but I have very strong reservations of not proceeding this afternoon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The comments of Senator-Judge Sotto are duly noted. Senator-Judge Alan Cayetano, thereafter, Senator-Judge Risa Hontiveros.

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, I share former Senator Tito Sotto's concern. Not to postpone.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Former Senate President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: Former Senate President, sorry. Former Senate President more than once. He was our majority, minority leader and Senate President in two administrations. Sorry, Senator Soto. But I agree with you na we shouldn't keep postponing. I agree with Congressman Diokno that we will move forward. Upon verification, I do agree that when the subpoena was issued and all these documents. But I also take note that the summaries were only sent this morning. And I don't mean to prejudge everything you've presented before this. But if I can use the word main event, one of the, if not the main event of this trial, the same as the corona trial, is actually the questions about financial impropriety or graph and corruption and about the actual finances of the respondent accused. So in a democracy, the result is important but the process is as important. That's why we all believe hopefully that the end does not justify the means. So, I don't think the defense is asking for a month, a week. They're asking for this afternoon and tomorrow. So, meaning on Monday. Because the problem, Mr. Presiding Officer, is that when we want the result right away, we also want fairness. There are so many issues from the Presiding Officer to the threshold through... Whether or not AMLLC has actually shown this document to others or have they been faithful in not sharing this document. Ang dami pong issues eh. So we don't want to add to that in saying that the defense wasn't given the opportunity to go through all of this and the senator-judges to see to the issues that the defense is... that the defense... Mayrace today or on Monday. So my point, Mr. President, is that just like the budget hearings, we have to balance the speed with fairness. So we all want results. Kung pwede, ipasa na natin yung 2027 budget tomorrow. Kung pwede, tapusin na natin ang prosecution tomorrow, next week yung defense na. But that has to be balanced with fairness. And it's the same thing in the... prosecution side. If the defense in their turn presents certain documents that you feel you need an afternoon or a day or weekend to read, I think prudence dictates that we give in to that. Subject to the defense not abusing that request na every time may dokumentong Tingin nila ngayon lang nila nakita ay hihingin nila na ipabukas o ipanext week na. So my small contribution today, Mr. President, is I think it will speak well of this impeachment court if we balance fairness and if the prosecution would so see fit that, you know, if you were in the shoes of the defense, you'd also like to go through all of this and make intelligent

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: Decisions from their comments to the offer to whether or not they will object to the presentation to questioning the witness and even asking the court whether or not this can be submitted to us or whatever it is. Fairness, I think, dictates that we give each other enough time. So that's my humble opinion, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Regardless po kung iyong mga pananalita ay galing sa prosecution o sa defense at bago po mag-ruling ang Presiding Officer para sa impeachment court, kailangan ko lang po sabihin ng representasyong ito, Mr. Presiding Officer, nasa isyong tinatalakay at importanteng i-gawin ito of record. para sa mga susunod na trial days na haharapin natin o di kaya para sa mga susunod na posibleng impeachment trial sa mga susunod na taon. Wala pong sinasabing absolute confidentiality na nagdatali sa kamay ng isang impeachment court sa usaping ito na tinatalakay natin sa ngayon. For the record po, Mr. Presiding Officer, yung confidentiality requirement para sa AMLAC officials sa mismong Anti-Money Laundering Act ay prohibition sa indiscriminate o voluntaryong pag-leak ng impormasyon. Hindi po yan prohibition sa compliance sa sabina issued ng isang proper court. Kasama na po ang isang impeachment court. Hindi po ito prohibition sa compliance o hindi po ito prohibition sa lawful disclosure ng impormasyon sa mga law enforcement agencies. Kasi po ang isang absolute reading ay magiging na pong Kabulastugan dahil hindi na po magagawa ng AMLOC ang mismong trabaho niya kung bakit siya nilikha ng ating batas. And in this case po, Mr. Presiding Officer, mukha namang willing mag-testigo ang AMLOC official. Ano pa man po ang maging ruling po ng Korte sa pamamagitan ng ating Presiding Officer kung itutuloy po niya ngayong hapon. or Bukas pa kaya. At magpatuloy ang trial na ito sa mga usapin ng records ng mga bangko sa susunod na linggo. Kinailangan lang po nitong representasyon bilang miyembro ng impeachment court na ito. Going of record po itong mga... Itong mga puntong ito. As I mentioned earlier, Mr. Presiding Officer, hindi lang para sa kasalukuyang trial, pero sa mga susunod pa kung sa kasagali, kung kailan ang mga impeachment courts na iyon ay maaaring mga ilangan tawagin ang AMLOC or rather... Either side, prosecution or defense, tawagin ang mga opisyal ng AMLAC bilang mga testigo, Mr. Presiding Officer. Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Presiding Officer. Just very briefly, I share the concern of some of our colleagues regarding the matter having been resolved by way of oral arguments in July. and as such therefore there should be no reason why we should go back reiterate or return to the debate but I also recognize that that this is a one day trial delay in other words I think the prosecution is asking for Monday so So, hindi naman nila hininging Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday. So, if we're going to miss one day to be able to process this and have both panels prepare, I would go by allowing for that one day, one trial day delay. I think it's reasonable in that regard. For the record, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Your Honor, Your Honor, if I may just make a brief manifestation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Make it brief, Atty. Honorable Chel.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: The request emanated from the defense, not from the prosecution. Just for the record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We confirm that. Chair will make a ruling.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Chair did not consider the sidebar of Atty. Sheila as a motion for reconsideration. As the Chair said earlier, ex abundante cautela, out of the exercise of extreme caution, the Chair decided. To furnish the Senator-Judges with a copy of, to be specific, Section 9C and Section 14D of RA No. 9160 as amended by Republic Act No. 11521, specifically Section 8A of the same. Again, out of an abundance of caution, just for them to be able to look at it again because the initial look-see was simply made by the presiding officer when it made a ruling in order to afford any senator-judge ample opportunity and time as well to raise a question if anyone should desire to do so and the matter will be settled either in caucus or in open session on Monday. Number two, on the requested time of the respondent or counsel-respondent to prepare adequately for the MLC, I believe this is the... Rather, the sequence mentioned by the lead prosecutor earlier. So, there...

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There being no other matters to be taken up, yes, Senator-Judge Zabiri, wala tayong session mamaya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay, um... The Honorable Chelle Diokno, I think, or the lead prosecutor would be in a better position to enumerate it once again for the information of the Senator-Judges. So we will begin with AMLC on Monday followed by BIR, I believe, if I remember correctly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And then the bank officials and then the insurance companies. The sequence of the bank officials will be as they appeared in the motion for the request for subpoena. and the sequence of the insurance companies will also be in the sequence as they appear in the motion for request for subpoena. The Clerk of Court is directed to come up with a calendar of the sequence of the witnesses for the information and reference of the Senator-Judges.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: If I recall, I'm sorry, Your Honor, thank you. If I recall the manifestation of the chair earlier, our team leader, I don't recall her mentioning the BIR unless it refers to the authenticating witnesses.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There was a subpoena for the BIR for October 5.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Insofar as the order is concerned, Your Honor, please, we will present, with the permission of the court, the banks and insurance companies before we present the BIR witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: To be fair, nag-iisa lang yung lamang ng motion for request for subpoena sa BIR. Wala siya sa sequence ng banks at insurance companies. So the BIR will be after the banks and the insurance companies?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We will come up with an advisory in accordance with this manifestation for the information of the Senator-judges and for confirmation by the parties too at the appropriate time on Monday. Attorney Sheila?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: We will present after, first we will begin with the Anti-Money Laundering Council Executive Director, Your Honor. Then we will proceed to the banks and insurance companies and present the BIR after.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If you will be in a position, Honorable Diokno, or anyone from the panel of prosecutors, Can you kindly furnish at least a day before any tables or summaries that any of your witnesses from the banks, insurance companies, or the BAR will be presenting to give adequate notice or sufficient notice, rather, and information to the counsel for the respondents to avoid this situation from occurring again next week?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: We will do so, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If you're in a position to do so.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno

turns.text: Senator-Judge, Lacson is recognized. What is your pleasure, sir?

turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President. This is for our fellow Senator-Judges. When we do our research over the weekend, kindly include Section 2, Republic Act 1405.
